findings.description: The deployment user is granted unrestricted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* permissions on every resource. Compromise of this access key or user would permit broad control over compute, object storage, Lambda functions, and monitoring resources, exceeding least-privilege access.
